text:
amanda: Planning to flip feature flag `dynamic-prefetch-v3` tonight during the quiet window. Target start 23:00 UTC. This is a two-step rollout: safe-defaults ON -> 1% canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Need who flips, who monitors, and rollback readiness.

kai: I can flip the initial 1% and watch the dashboards for the first 15m. Will handover to jordan for the larger increments.

jordan: OK. I'll be available for the 5% -> 20% steps. What should our smoke checks be?

amanda: Good q. Minimal smoke checklist: 1) error rate <= baseline + 0.1% 2) p95 latency within +50ms 3) no increased 5xx spikes on /api/generate 4) KV cache hit rate doesn't drop by >5%. Quick commands: 
```
# toggle (internal tool)
/ff toggle dynamic-prefetch-v3 --percent=1 --note="canary 1% 23:00 UTC"
# rollback
/ff toggle dynamic-prefetch-v3 --percent=0 --note="rollback - emergency"
```

sara: I'll be the pager backup. If error rate > threshold or p95 jumps, page oncall and we rollback. Also suggest enabling safedefaults flag during the flip if not already set.

kai: safedefaults is currently ON for this flag (checked). I'll post a screenshot of the dashboard at +10m.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window is 23:00-01:00 UTC. Quiet window auto-escalation rule active. Logs channel will mirror alerts to #incidents.

jordan: For monitoring, we'll watch: infra.metrics.prefetch.error_rate, infra.metrics.prefetch.p95_latency, and app.requests.5xx. Also keep an eye on per-tenant QPS for heavy tenants.

amanda: Good call. Plan: 
- 23:00 toggle to 1% (kai) -> observe 15m 
- 23:20 escalate to 5% (jordan) -> observe 10m 
- 23:35 escalate to 20% (jordan) -> observe 20m 
- After stable, 00:00 final lift to 100% (amanda)

If rollback needed at any step, whoever detects issue runs the rollback command and posts "rollback:reason" in thread. We won't proceed until safed for 30m after any rollback.

sara: I'll open an incident stub in #incidents before the flip so we have a place for notes if needed.

kai: quick preflight checks i've done: canary infra green, canary model variant available on all regions, safedefaults ON, smoke script ready: `scripts/smoke-prefetch-check.sh`

jordan: added one more: confirm circuit-breaker thresholds unchanged. I checked prod config and it's unchanged.

amanda: perfect. Who officially owns the flip? Kai for initial, Jordan for mid, Amanda for full. If anyone needs a hand, ping oncall or @sara. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 22:50 UTC to this thread.

amanda: Thanks all — i'll post a final "starting" message 5m before. If silent ack, assume on-call rota covers monitoring.

sara: ack. I'll be watching alerts channel.

kai: ready.

jordan: ready.

amanda: starting window at 22:55 local check-in then flip at 23:00.
